stemBlocks: A uniform square trap door of side $0.80 \text{ m}$ and mass $14 \text{ kg}$ has a smooth hinge at one edge and is held open at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. It is supported by a single rigid rod placed so that it meets the surface of the trap door at $90^{\circ}$ at a distance $0.10 \text{ m}$ from the top edge of the trap door, as shown.
What is the normal contact force exerted on the trap door by the rod?
